summary: Loads Scalable Display calibration data and exposes projection/camera transform data for projector calibration workflows.

key_params.name: near
key_params.note: Near plane value for calibration camera data.

key_params.name: far
key_params.note: Far plane value for calibration camera data.

key_params.name: eyepoint
key_params.note: Eye point for dynamic calibration files.

common_gotchas: Use the operator projection and cameraTransform Python members in a Camera COMP to apply the calibration.
A missing or incompatible calibration file means this TOP cannot produce useful projector data.
key_concepts: Loads Scalable Display calibration data for projector calibration workflows.
Exposes projection and cameraTransform Python members for use by a Camera COMP.
Near, Far, and Eye Point parameters shape the camera data exported from dynamic/POL calibration files.
Official docs mark this TOP as TouchDesigner Pro-only and Microsoft Windows-only.
